what_i_did: No turnaround, so per the AD the hero is the only target. make_views.py keys the hero against its cream backdrop; the olive cast shadow has the same hue range as the leaves, so below row 1600 (of 2048) only hand-traced polygons round the lowest rosette leaves and the stem base are kept. views/hero.png and views/hero_mask.png.

hero_check.py renders front-on (yaw 0) from 15 deg up with the harness lens and scores the silhouette against views/hero.png. It is the AD's matched camera; a calibration grid would have preferred 18 deg and yaw -15, which I did not use.

10 broad oval leaf cards (6 triangles, cupped edges, drooping tips) radiating flat from the crown, 0.17-0.185 m long, two of them straddling the front, clamped to the ground. Leaf_Green with every third Leaf_Pale.

50 oval leaves (0.8 width ratio) aimed from near the axis at tip points on a dome envelope: half-width 0.16 m up to 0.22 m, narrowing to 0.08 m at 0.29 m, 20 % fuller on the right as in the hero, each rolled about its midrib so its face shows. A 6-sided faceted core inside keeps the mass solid.

6 curved upright Stem_Green stems (3-sided) with 2 small leaves each, short green side branches, and a short Stem_Red stalk under each of 15 hand-placed five-point Petal_Blue stars (0.068 m across, points cupped forward) with a pale Flower_White pentagonal cone centre. Flowers in the leaf dome are pushed out onto its surface; two nod sideways-down at the left and upper right.

993 triangles (budget 1k), 6 meshes, one flat material each: Leaf_Green, Leaf_Pale, Stem_Green, Stem_Red, Petal_Blue, Flower_White, all double-sided. 0.368 x 0.327 x 0.410 m (old GF-249: 0.338 x 0.319 x 0.412), origin at the base on the ground. No animation, no variants. to_game.py borage ran cleanly and GF-249.glb is byte-identical to borage.glb.
good: Hero IoU 0.657 at 768 px: a dome-shaped clump on a wider flat rosette with blue stars spread through the upper half and round the edges, aspect close to the hero's.
Reads at tile distance as a green mound sprinkled with chunky bright-blue stars with white eyes; red flower stalks show at the tips.
Same height as the old model and nearly the same footprint, under the 1k budget.
off: The hero's silhouette is ragged with many separate leaf tips, stems and hairs; at 1k triangles the edge is coarser, which caps the IoU around 0.65-0.69 (seed noise +-0.015).
Width is 0.368 m against the old 0.338 m (+9 %): the hero's rosette is clearly wider than a 0.34 m footprint allows at 0.41 m tall. Depth 0.327 m matches.
The hero's upper stems carry more leaves; here the stems above the body are mostly bare, to spend triangles on the body silhouette.
Hairs and the dark anther cone in the flower centre are left out (stylised to a pale centre as asked).

rounds.change: First build: 9-leaf rosette, 18 small body leaves, 6 hand-placed stems to 15 hero-placed stars. 867 tris. Far too sparse.
Body leaves 30 and larger, broader star points, smaller centres, 3-segment stems.
6-triangle leaf cards (was 8) to afford 40 body leaves; 10 rosette leaves.
Stretched flower layout 1.12x sideways; whole clump scaled to the old 0.41 m height.
Longer rosette, steeper body leaves (worse, reverted in part).
Hero camera fixed at front-on, 15 deg up (inside the AD's 10-15 deg; calibration grid liked 18 deg / yaw -15, not used). Leaves climbing the stems instead of a body (worse).
Body leaves rise outward with height (lean) - single long leaves stuck out and widened the bbox.
Body leaves aimed at tip points on a dome envelope (half-width body_R to a shoulder, then narrowing).
Leaves rolled 30-60 deg about the midrib so they show width from the front.
Wider body envelope, round rosette.
Flower spread back to hero scale (1.0), longer rosette.
Body shoulder raised to 0.25 m, 40 body leaves.
Flatter rosette, body fuller on the right as in the hero.
Shorter front/back rosette leaves; 48 broader body leaves.
Bug fix: rosette squash now shortens front/back leaves; broader rosette leaves (w 0.7).
54 body leaves, nodding flowers opened toward the side, flowers 0.062 m across; seed sweep +-0.015 noise, seed 7 kept.
Two rosette leaves straddle the front (phase 0), body skew 0.2 to the right.
Low faceted foliage core (Leaf_Green) inside the body so it reads solid; body half-width 0.16-0.17.
Footprint pulled back toward the old model (rosette 0.17-0.185 m, body_R 0.16).
Rounder plan (depth squash 0.95) to bring the depth up to the old 0.32 m.
Flowers inside the leaf dome moved out to its surface so ~13 show from the front; body top lowered to 0.29 m. Bigger stars (r 0.034).
Trimmed to budget (50 body leaves, 6-sided core): 993 tris. Final 768 px / 48 samples; to_game.py borage.

moving_parts: None. The game poses and sways plants itself; export_animations=False.
creative_additions: A faceted core inside the leaf mass so it reads solid at tile distance, star points cupped forward so the flowers catch light, and the hero's right-heavy fullness kept as a body skew.
